description: `super()` is an escape site taking the base constructor's effective-body color, so inside a marked derived constructor it is reported at the `super()` itself.

diagnostics.message: Call to `Base` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `Base` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
